p.title: 13F ledger scope and turnover label; KR themes read from completed closes
p.symptom: Berkshire's change ledger showed the 10-row embedded preview first and 30 rows only after another view loaded the manager shard; "회전율 대용치 7.8%" was the distance between reported-value weights (price moves alone change it); the KR theme block promised 수급·모멘텀·성과 while live coverage was 0/28.
p.root_cause: The ledger used whatever comparison rows were loaded; the KR block depended only on live quotes.
p.fix: masters: when the preview is shorter than the verified comparison count, the ledger says "전체 비교 N행 중 미리보기 M행" with a button that loads the full shard (initial-load budget unchanged); the metric is renamed "보고가치 비중 변화(회전율 아님)". kr-themes krThemeArtifactRead: median 1-/3-month return and 50-day share per KRX theme from the screener artifact (25 of 28 themes covered), rendered at the top of the KR block with the coverage in its summary.
p.violated_rule: Review 2026-10-04 (institutional standard): what a number is called must match how it was computed — completed sessions, one model for ranking and validation, one currency and denominator, named definitions.
p.prevention: ci-three-page-artifact-budget-check keeps the deferred shard; browser groups cover themes and masters.
p.verification: Local: KR block reads "강한 테마는 반도체(+27.5%) · 에너지(+9.6%) · 로봇(+4.5%)…" with 12 bars.

changelog: **13F·국내 테마 (P1444):** 변화 원장이 미리보기만 보여줄 때 그 범위를 밝히고 전체 원장 불러오기를 제공, '회전율 대용치'는 '보고가치 비중 변화(회전율 아님)'로. 국내 테마는 스크리너 완료 종가로 1·3개월 흐름을 보여줍니다.
